name: Disneyland & DCA Outdoor Fruit Carts: Fresh Ripe Banana & Cut Cantaloupe/Honeydew Cup
brandOrRestaurant: Main Street Fruit Cart, Ship to Shore & Fillmore's Taste-In (Disneyland & DCA)
whyItWorks: Whole ripe bananas ($2–$3 at fruit carts in every land) and chilled seedless cantaloupe/honeydew melon cups are hydrating, potassium-rich, and 9.5/10 flare-safe.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up 2 ripe bananas at Main Street Fruit Cart (Disneyland) or Fillmore's Taste-In (Cars Land DCA) each morning to keep in your park bag—never add the Tajín chili-lime packet!
watchOuts: Discard the Tajín chili-lime seasoning packet often offered with fruit cups (chili + dehydrated lime trigger)
